final: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT product_color, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_line_items FROM Invoice_Line_Items JOIN Products USING (product_id) GROUP BY product_color), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_item_count) AS average_count FROM color_counts) SELECT AVG(line_item_count) AS average_count, AVG(share_of_line_items) AS average_share, AVG(line_item_count - overall.average_count) AS average_excess FROM color_counts CROSS JOIN overall WHERE line_item_count > overall.average_count
